id.description: Phase.subtask format, e.g. '2.3'. Unique across all tasks.

scope.description: Commit scope — short label (1-2 words) for the area this task touches, e.g. 'auth', 'db', 'api'.

description.description: What to build. One line. Clear enough that a coding agent understands the task without reading the spec.

file.description: Primary file to create or edit. Relative to repo root.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must have passes: true before this task can start. Empty array if no dependencies.

verify.description: Shell command to verify task completion. Must be runnable by the coding agent. Exit 0 = pass.

estimated_size.description: small: <30 min. medium: 30-90 min. large: 90+ min — should be split into smaller tasks.

passes.description: Always false when created. Only CI pipeline changes this to true.
